units.translation: The bliss described in Śruti from the universal ruler up to Brahmā is perishable and graded; when its cause is exhausted, it dissolves.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
sārva-bhaumādi-brahmāntaṃ śrutyā yaḥ pratipāditaḥ|
sa kṣayiṣṇuḥ sātiśayaḥ prakṣīṇe kāraṇe layam||

units.label: Verse 650
units.deva:
यात्येष विषयानन्दो यस् तु पुण्यैक-साधनः।
ये तु वैषयिकानन्दं भुञ्जते पुण्य-कारिणः॥
units.translation: This object-based bliss, which depends solely on merit, passes away. Those who enjoy sense-based bliss are people who have performed meritorious acts.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yātyeṣa viṣayānando yas tu puṇyaika-sādhanaḥ|
ye tu vaiṣayikānandaṃ bhuñjate puṇya-kāriṇaḥ||

units.label: Verse 651
units.deva:
दुःखं च भोग-कालेऽपि तेषाम् अन्ते महत्तरम्।
सुखं विषय-सम्पृक्तं विष-सम्पृक्त-भक्तवत्॥
units.translation: For them there is suffering even during enjoyment, and greater suffering at its end. Happiness mixed with sense objects is like food mixed with poison.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
duḥkhaṃ ca bhoga-kāle’pi teṣām ante mahattaram|
sukhaṃ viṣaya-sampṛktaṃ viṣa-sampṛkta-bhaktavat||

units.label: Verse 652
units.deva:
भोग-कालेऽपि भोगान्ते दुःखम् एव प्रयच्छति।
सुखम् उच्चावचत्वेन क्षयिष्णुत्व-भयेन च॥
units.translation: Even during enjoyment and at its end, it gives only suffering. Happiness is subject to greater and lesser degrees and to the fear of perishing.

gloss.en: because of greater and lesser degrees
because of the fear of perishing

units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
bhoga-kāle’pi bhogānte duḥkham eva prayacchati|
sukham uccāvacatvena kṣayiṣṇutva-bhayena ca||

units.label: Verse 653
units.deva:
भोग-काले भवेन् नॄणां ब्रह्मादि-पद-भागिनाम्।
राज-स्थान-प्रविष्टानां तारतम्यं मतं यथा॥
units.translation: At the time of enjoyment, people occupying ranks from Brahmā onward have different degrees of happiness, just as those admitted to a king’s court have different ranks.

gloss.en: who occupy ranks beginning with Brahmā
of those admitted to a royal court

units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
bhoga-kāle bhaven nṝṇāṃ brahmādi-pada-bhāginām|
rāja-sthāna-praviṣṭānāṃ tāratamyaṃ mataṃ yathā||

units.label: Verse 654
units.deva:
तथैव दुःखं जन्तूनां ब्रह्मादि-पद-भागिनाम्।
न काङ्क्षणीयं विदुषा तस्माद् वैषयिकं सुखम्॥
units.translation: Likewise, there is suffering for beings who occupy ranks from Brahmā onward. Therefore the wise should not desire sense-based happiness.

gloss.en: who occupy ranks beginning with Brahmā

units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tathaiva duḥkhaṃ jantūnāṃ brahmādi-pada-bhāginām|
na kāṅkṣaṇīyaṃ viduṣā tasmād vaiṣayikaṃ sukham||

units.label: Verse 655
units.deva:
यो बिम्ब-भूत आनन्दः स आत्मानन्द-लक्षणः।
शाश्वतो निर्द्वयः पूर्णो नित्य एकोऽपि निर्भयः॥
units.translation: The original bliss is the nature of the Self’s bliss: eternal, nondual, full, enduring, one, and fearless.

gloss.en: the nature of the Self’s bliss

units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yo bimba-bhūta ānandaḥ sa ātmānanda-lakṣaṇaḥ|
śāśvato nirdvayaḥ pūrṇo nitya eko’pi nirbhayaḥ||

units.label: Verse 656
units.deva:
लक्ष्यते प्रतिबिम्बेनाभासानन्देन बिम्बवत्।
प्रतिबिम्बो बिम्ब-मूलो विना बिम्बं न सिध्यति॥
units.translation: The original is indicated by the reflected, apparent bliss. A reflection has the original as its source; without an original, no reflection is established.

gloss.en: has the original as its source

units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
lakṣyate pratibimbenābhāsānandena bimbavat|
pratibimbo bimba-mūlo vinā bimbaṃ na sidhyati||

units.label: Verse 657
units.deva:
यत् ततो बिम्ब आनन्दः प्रतिबिम्बेन लक्ष्यते।
युक्त्यैव पण्डित-जनैर् न कदाप्यनुभूयते॥
units.translation: The original bliss, which is indicated through reflected bliss, is never directly experienced by learned people through reasoning alone.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yat tato bimba ānandaḥ pratibimbena lakṣyate|
yuktyaiva paṇḍita-janair na kadāpyanubhūyate||

units.label: Verse 658
units.deva:
अविद्या-कार्य-करण-सङ्घातेषु पुरोदितः।
आत्मा जाग्रत्यपि स्वप्ने न भवत्येष गोचरः॥
units.translation: Though previously mentioned among the aggregates of instruments produced by ignorance, the Self is not an object in waking or in dream.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
avidyā-kārya-karaṇa-saṅghāteṣu puroditaḥ|
ātmā jāgratyapi svapne na bhavatyeṣa gocaraḥ||

units.label: Verse 659
units.deva:
स्थूलस्यापि च सूक्ष्मस्य दुःख-रूपस्य वर्ष्मणः।
लये सुषुप्तौ स्फुरति प्रत्यग् आनन्द-लक्षणः॥
units.translation: When the gross and subtle bodies, whose nature is suffering, dissolve in deep sleep, the inward Self marked by bliss shines.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
sthūlasyāpi ca sūkṣmasya duḥkha-rūpasya varṣmaṇaḥ|
laye suṣuptau sphurati pratyag ānanda-lakṣaṇaḥ||

units.label: Verse 660
units.deva:
न ह्यत्र विषयः कश्चिन् नापि बुद्ध्यादि किञ्चन।
आत्मैव केवलानन्द-मात्रस् तिष्ठति निर्द्वयः॥
units.translation: There is no object here, nor anything such as the intellect. The Self alone, nothing but bliss, remains nondual.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
na hyatra viṣayaḥ kaścin nāpi buddhyādi kiñcana|
ātmaiva kevalānanda-mātras tiṣṭhati nirdvayaḥ||

units.label: Verse 661
units.deva:
प्रत्यभिज्ञायते सर्वैर् एष सुप्तोत्थितैर् जनैः।
सुख-मात्रतया नात्र संशयं कर्तुम् अर्हसि॥
units.translation: All people who have risen from sleep recognize this [Self] as happiness alone; you should have no doubt about this.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
pratyabhijñāyate sarvair eṣa suptotthitair janaiḥ|
sukha-mātratayā nātra saṃśayaṃ kartum arhasi||

units.label: Verse 662
units.deva:
त्वयापि प्रत्यभिज्ञातं सुख-मात्रत्वम् आत्मनः।
सुषुप्ताद् उत्थितवता सुखम् अस्वाप्सम् इत्यनु॥
units.translation: You too have recognized that the Self is happiness alone, when, having risen from deep sleep, you then say, “I slept happily.”
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tvayāpi pratyabhijñātaṃ sukha-mātratvam ātmanaḥ|
suṣuptād utthitavatā sukham asvāpsam ityanu||

units.label: Verse 663
units.deva:
दुःखाभावः सुखम् इति यद् उक्तं पूर्व-वादिना।
अनाघ्रातोपनिषदा तद् असारं मृषा वचः॥
units.translation: What the previous disputant said—“The absence of sorrow is happiness”—is an empty, false claim from someone untouched by the Upaniṣads.
gloss: by one untouched by the Upaniṣads
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
duḥkhābhāvaḥ sukham iti yad uktaṃ pūrva-vādinā|
anāghrātopaniṣadā tad asāraṃ mṛṣā vacaḥ||

units.label: Verse 664
units.deva:
दुःखाभावस् तु लोष्टादौ विद्यते नानुभूयते।
सुख-लेशोऽपि सर्वेषां प्रत्यक्षं तद् इदं खलु॥
units.translation: The absence of sorrow exists in a clod of earth and the like, but is not experienced. Yet every person directly experiences at least a trace of happiness; this is indeed so.
gloss: in a clod of earth and the like
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
duḥkhābhāvas tu loṣṭādau vidyate nānubhūyate|
sukha-leśo’pi sarveṣāṃ pratyakṣaṃ tad idaṃ khalu||

units.label: Verse 665
units.deva:
सद् अयं ह्येष एवेति प्रस्तुत्य वदति श्रुतिः।
सद्-घनोऽयं चिद्-घनोऽयम् आनन्द-घन इत्यपि॥
units.translation: Having first declared, “This [Self] is indeed Being itself,” the Śruti also says, “This is fullness of Being, fullness of consciousness, and fullness of bliss.”
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
sad ayaṃ hyeṣa eveti prastutya vadati śrutiḥ|
sad-ghano’yaṃ cid-ghano’yam ānanda-ghana ityapi||

units.label: Verse 666
units.deva:
आनन्द-घनताम् अस्य स्व-रूपं प्रत्यग्-आत्मनः।
धन्यैर् महात्मभिर् धीरैर् ब्रह्मविद्भिः सद्-उत्तमैः॥
units.translation: Blessed, great-souled, steadfast knowers of Brahman, the noblest among the good, hold fullness of bliss to be the very nature of this inward Self.
gloss: by knowers of Brahman, the noblest among the good
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
ānanda-ghanatām asya sva-rūpaṃ pratyag-ātmanaḥ|
dhanyair mahātmabhir dhīrair brahmavidbhiḥ sad-uttamaiḥ||

units.label: Verse 667
units.deva:
अपरोक्षतयैवात्मा समाधावनुभूयते।
केवलानन्द-मात्रत्वेनैवम् अत्र न संशयः॥
units.translation: The Self is experienced directly in samādhi, as bliss alone. There is no doubt about this.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
aparokṣatayaivātmā samādhāvanubhūyate|
kevalānanda-mātratvenaivam atra na saṃśayaḥ||

units.label: Verse 668
units.deva:
स्व-स्वोपाध्यनुरूपेण ब्रह्माद्याः सर्व-जन्तवः।
उपजीवन्त्य् अमुष्येव मात्राम् आनन्द-लक्षणाम्॥
units.translation: All beings, from Brahmā onward, live on a measure of that very bliss, according to their own limiting adjuncts.
gloss: according to each one's own limiting adjunct
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
sva-svopādhyanurūpeṇa brahmādyāḥ sarva-jantavaḥ|
upajīvanty amuṣyeva mātrām ānanda-lakṣaṇām||

units.label: Verse 669
units.deva:
आस्वाद्यते यो भक्ष्येषु सुख-कृन् मधुरो रसः।
स गुडस्यैव नो तेषां माधुर्यं विद्यते क्वचित्॥
units.translation: The sweet, pleasure-giving taste savored in foods comes from jaggery alone; no sweetness is present in those foods themselves.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
āsvādyate yo bhakṣyeṣu sukha-kṛn madhuro rasaḥ|
sa guḍasyaiva no teṣāṃ mādhuryaṃ vidyate kvacit||

units.label: Verse 670
units.deva:
तद्वद् विषय-सांनिध्याद् आनन्दो यः प्रतीयते।
बिम्बानन्दांश-विस्फूर्तिर् एवासौ न जडात्मनाम्॥
units.translation: Likewise, the happiness perceived because an object is present is only the appearance of a portion of original bliss; it does not belong intrinsically to insentient objects.
gloss: a manifestation of a portion of original bliss
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tadvad viṣaya-sāṃnidhyād ānando yaḥ pratīyate|
bimbānandāṃśa-visphūrtir evāsau na jaḍātmanām||

units.label: Verse 671
units.deva:
यस्य कस्यापि योगेन यत्र कुत्रापि दृश्यते।
आनन्दः स परस्यैव ब्रह्मणः स्फूर्ति-लक्षणः॥
units.translation: Wherever happiness is seen through association with anything at all, that happiness is a manifestation of the supreme Brahman alone.
gloss: having the character of a manifestation
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yasya kasyāpi yogena yatra kutrāpi dṛśyate|
ānandaḥ sa parasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ sphūrti-lakṣaṇaḥ||

units.label: Verse 672
units.deva:
यथा कुवलयोल्लासश् चन्द्रस्यैव प्रसादतः।
तथानन्दोदयोऽप्येषां स्फुरणाद् एव वस्तुनः॥
units.translation: Just as the water lily blooms through the moon's favor alone, so the arising of happiness in these beings comes only from the shining of Reality.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yathā kuvalayollāsaś candrasyaiva prasādataḥ|
tathānandodayo’pyeṣāṃ sphuraṇād eva vastunaḥ||

units.label: Verse 673
units.deva:
सत्त्वं चित्त्वं तथानन्दः स्वरूपं परमात्मनः।
निर्गुणस्य गुणायोगाद् गुणास् तु न भवन्ति ते॥
units.translation: Being, consciousness, and bliss are the very nature of the Supreme Self. Since the qualityless Self is not joined to qualities, these are not qualities [of it].
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
sattvaṃ cittvaṃ tathānandaḥ svarūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ|
nirguṇasya guṇāyogād guṇās tu na bhavanti te||

units.label: Verse 674
units.deva:
विशेषणं तु व्यावृत्त्यै भवेद् द्रव्यान्तरे सति।
परमात्माद्वितीयोऽयं प्रपञ्चस्य मृषात्वतः॥
units.translation: An attribute serves to distinguish one thing when another entity exists. Since the world is unreal, this Supreme Self is without a second.
gloss: this Supreme Self is without a second
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
viśeṣaṇaṃ tu vyāvṛttyai bhaved dravyāntare sati|
paramātmādvitīyo’yaṃ prapañcasya mṛṣātvataḥ||

units.label: Verse 675
units.deva:
वस्त्वन्तरस्याभावेन न व्यावर्त्यः कदाचन।
केवलो निर्गुणश् चेति निर्गुणत्वं निरुच्यते॥
units.translation: Because no other reality exists, the Self can never be distinguished from anything else. It is said to be alone and without qualities; this is what “qualityless” means.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
vastvantarasyābhāvena na vyāvartyaḥ kadācana|
kevalo nirguṇaś ceti nirguṇatvaṃ nirucyate||

units.label: Verse 676
units.deva:
श्रुत्यैव न ततस् तेषां गुणत्वम् उपपद्यते।
उष्णत्वं च प्रकाशश्च यथा वह्नेस् तथात्मनः॥
units.translation: Thus it is not fitting to treat those [features] as qualities on the basis of Śruti alone. As heat and light belong to fire, so [being, consciousness, and bliss] belong to the Self.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
śrutyaiva na tatas teṣāṃ guṇatvam upapadyate|
uṣṇatvaṃ ca prakāśaśca yathā vahnes tathātmanaḥ||

units.label: Verse 677
units.deva:
सत्त्व-चित्त्वानन्दतादि स्व-रूपम् इति निश्चितम्।
अत एव सजातीय-विजातीयादि-लक्षणः॥
units.translation: It is established that being, consciousness, bliss, and the like are the Self's own nature; hence the distinctions defined by same-kind, different-kind, and the like …
gloss: being, consciousness, bliss, and the like
defined by same-kind, different-kind, and the like
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
sattva-cittvānandatādi sva-rūpam iti niścitam|
ata eva sajātīya-vijātīyādi-lakṣaṇaḥ||

units.label: Verse 678
units.deva:
भेदो न विद्यते वस्तुन्य् अद्वितीये परात्मनि।
प्रपञ्चस्यापवादेन विजातीय-कृता भिदा॥
units.translation: …do not exist in the nondual reality, the Supreme Self. Difference based on an unlike thing is removed when the manifest world is negated.
gloss: produced by something of a different kind
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
bhedo na vidyate vastuny advitīye parātmani|
prapañcasyāpavādena vijātīya-kṛtā bhidā||

units.label: Verse 679
units.deva:
नेष्यते तत्-प्रकारं ते वक्ष्यामि शृणु सादरम्।
अहेर् गुण-विवर्तस्य गुण-मात्रस्य वस्तुतः॥
units.translation: That manner [of explanation] is not accepted; I shall explain it to you. Listen carefully: the apparent serpent is a transformation of a cord and is, in reality, cord alone.
gloss: of an apparent transformation of a cord
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
neṣyate tat-prakāraṃ te vakṣyāmi śṛṇu sādaram|
aher guṇa-vivartasya guṇa-mātrasya vastutaḥ||

units.label: Verse 680
units.deva:
विवर्तस्यास्य जगतः सन्-मात्रत्वेन दर्शनम्।
अपवाद इति प्राहुर् अद्वैत-ब्रह्म-दर्शिनः॥
units.translation: The seers of nondual Brahman call seeing this world-appearance as nothing but Being “negation.”
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
vivartasyāsya jagataḥ san-mātratvena darśanam|
apavāda iti prāhur advaita-brahma-darśinaḥ||

units.label: Verse 681
units.deva:
व्युत्क्रमेण तद्-उत्पत्तेर् द्रष्टव्यं सूक्ष्म-बुद्धिभिः।
प्रतीतस्यास्य जगतः सन्-मात्रत्वं सुयुक्तिभिः॥
units.translation: By retracing its origin in reverse order, those with subtle intellect should see, through sound reasoning, that this perceived world is nothing but Being.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
vyutkrameṇa tad-utpatter draṣṭavyaṃ sūkṣma-buddhibhiḥ|
pratītasyāsya jagataḥ san-mātratvaṃ suyuktibhiḥ||

units.label: Verse 682
units.deva:
चतुर्विधं स्थूल-शरीर-जातं
तद्-भोज्यम् अन्नादि तद्-आश्रयादि।
ब्रह्माण्डम् एतत् सकलं स्थविष्ठम्
ईक्षेत पञ्ची-कृत-भूत-मात्रम्॥
units.translation: One should regard this entire, gross cosmic whole as made only of the fivefold elements: the four kinds of gross body, their food and the like, and their supports and the like.
gloss: made only of the fivefold elements
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
caturvidhaṃ sthūla-śarīra-jātaṃ
tad-bhojyam annādi tad-āśrayādi|
brahmāṇḍam etat sakalaṃ sthaviṣṭham
īkṣeta pañcī-kṛta-bhūta-mātram||

units.label: Verse 683
units.deva:
यत्-कार्य-रूपेण यद् ईक्ष्यते तत्
तन्-मात्रम् एवात्र विचार्यमाणे।
मृत्-कार्य-भूतं कलशादि सम्यग्
विचारितं सन् न मृदो विभिद्यते॥
units.translation: Whatever is seen in the form of an effect, on examination, is only its cause. A jar and other things made of clay, when carefully examined, are not separate from the clay.
gloss: in the form of an effect
made as an effect of clay
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yat-kārya-rūpeṇa yad īkṣyate tat
tan-mātram evātra vicāryamāṇe|
mṛt-kārya-bhūtaṃ kalaśādi samyag
vicāritaṃ san na mṛdo vibhidyate||

units.label: Verse 684
units.deva:
अन्तर् बहिश् चापि मृद् एव दृश्यते
मृदो न भिन्नं कलशादि किञ्चन।
ग्रीवादिमद् यत् कलशं तद् इत्थं
न वाच्यम् एतच् च मृद् एव नान्यत्॥
units.translation: Clay alone is seen both inside and outside; a jar and the like are in no way different from clay. Even a pot with a neck and other features should not be spoken of as something else: it too is clay alone, nothing else.
gloss: having a neck and the like
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
antar bahiś cāpi mṛd eva dṛśyate
mṛdo na bhinnaṃ kalaśādi kiñcana|
grīvādimad yat kalaśaṃ tad itthaṃ
na vācyam etac ca mṛd eva nānyat||

units.label: Verse 685
units.deva:
स्व-रूपतस् तत् कलशादि-नाम्ना
मृद् एव मूढैर् अभिधीयते ततः।
नाम्नो हि भेदो न तु वस्तु-भेदः।
प्रदृश्यते तत्र विचार्यमाणे॥
units.translation: In its nature it is clay alone, but the deluded call it by names such as “jar.” On examination, one sees a difference in name, not a difference in the thing itself.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
sva-rūpatas tat kalaśādi-nāmnā
mṛd eva mūḍhair abhidhīyate tataḥ|
nāmno hi bhedo na tu vastu-bhedaḥ|
pradṛśyate tatra vicāryamāṇe||

units.label: Verse 686
units.deva:
तस्माद्धि कार्यं न कदापि भिन्नं
स्व-कारणाद् अस्ति यतस् ततोऽङ्ग।
यद् भौतिकं सर्वम् इदं तथैव
तद् भूत-मात्रं न ततोऽपि भिन्नम्॥
units.translation: Therefore, dear one, an effect is never separate from its own cause, since it exists through that cause. Likewise, all this material world is only the elements and is not separate even from them.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tasmāddhi kāryaṃ na kadāpi bhinnaṃ
sva-kāraṇād asti yatas tato’ṅga|
yad bhautikaṃ sarvam idaṃ tathaiva
tad bhūta-mātraṃ na tato’pi bhinnam||

units.label: Verse 687
units.deva:
तच् चापि पञ्ची-कृत-भूत-जातं
शब्दादिभिः स्व-स्व-गुणैश्च सार्धम्।
वपूंषि सूक्ष्माणि च सर्वम् एतद्
भवत्यपञ्ची-कृत-भूत-मात्रम्॥
units.translation: That group of fivefold elements, together with their respective qualities such as sound, and the subtle bodies—this whole becomes only the unquintuplicated elements.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tac cāpi pañcī-kṛta-bhūta-jātaṃ
śabdādibhiḥ sva-sva-guṇaiśca sārdham|
vapūṃṣi sūkṣmāṇi ca sarvam etad
bhavatyapañcī-kṛta-bhūta-mātram||

units.label: Verse 688
units.deva:
तद् अप्यपञ्ची-कृत-भूत-जातं
रजस्-तमः-सत्त्व-गुणैश्च सार्धम्।
अव्यक्त-मात्रं भवति स्व-रूपतः
साभासम् अव्यक्तम् इदं स्वयं च॥
units.translation: That group of unquintuplicated elements, together with the qualities of rajas, tamas, and sattva, is in its nature only the unmanifest; and this unmanifest itself is accompanied by an appearance.
gloss: with the qualities rajas, tamas, and sattva
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tad apyapañcī-kṛta-bhūta-jātaṃ
rajas-tamaḥ-sattva-guṇaiśca sārdham|
avyakta-mātraṃ bhavati sva-rūpataḥ
sābhāsam avyaktam idaṃ svayaṃ ca||

units.label: Verse 689
units.deva:
आधार-भूतं यद् अखण्डम् आद्यं
शुद्धं परं ब्रह्म सदैक-रूपम्।
सन्-मात्रम् एवास्त्यथ नो विकल्पः
सतः परं केवलम् एव वस्तु॥
units.translation: The support, indivisible, primordial, pure, supreme Brahman is always of one nature. Only Being exists; there is no other reality beyond Being.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
ādhāra-bhūtaṃ yad akhaṇḍam ādyaṃ
śuddhaṃ paraṃ brahma sadaika-rūpam|
san-mātram evāstyatha no vikalpaḥ
sataḥ paraṃ kevalam eva vastu||

units.label: Verse 690
units.deva:
एकश् चन्द्रः सद्-वितीयो यथा स्याद्
दृष्टेर् दोषाद् एव पुंसस् तथैकम्।
ब्रह्मास्त्य् एतद् बुद्धि-दोषेण नाना
दोषे नष्टे भाति वस्त्वेकम् एव॥
units.translation: Just as one moon appears double to a person because of a defect in vision, so the one Brahman appears manifold because of a defect in understanding. When the defect is gone, the one Reality shines.
gloss: because of a defect in understanding
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
ekaś candraḥ sad-vitīyo yathā syād
dṛṣṭer doṣād eva puṃsas tathaikam|
brahmāsty etad buddhi-doṣeṇa nānā
doṣe naṣṭe bhāti vastvekam eva||

units.label: Verse 691
units.deva:
रज्जोः स्व-रूपाधि-गमे न सर्प-धी
रज्ज्वां विलीना तु यथा तथैव।
ब्रह्मावगत्या तु जगत्-प्रतीतिस्
तत्रैव लीना तु सह भ्रमेण॥
units.translation: Just as, when a rope's true nature is known, the thought of a snake dissolves into the rope, so when Brahman is realized, the appearance of the world dissolves there along with the delusion.
gloss: when its true nature is grasped
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
rajjoḥ sva-rūpādhi-game na sarpa-dhī
rajjvāṃ vilīnā tu yathā tathaiva|
brahmāvagatyā tu jagat-pratītis
tatraiva līnā tu saha bhrameṇa||

units.label: Verse 692
units.deva:
भ्रान्त्योदित-द्वैत-मति-प्रशान्त्या
सदैकम् एवास्ति सदाद्वितीयम्।
ततो विजातीय-कृतोऽत्र भेदो
न विद्यते ब्रह्मणि निर्विकल्पे॥
units.translation: When the dualistic thought born of error subsides, only Being remains, always without a second. Therefore no difference produced by something of another kind exists in Brahman, which is free of distinctions.
gloss: produced by something of a different kind
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
bhrāntyodita-dvaita-mati-praśāntyā
sadaikam evāsti sadādvitīyam|
tato vijātīya-kṛto’tra bhedo
na vidyate brahmaṇi nirvikalpe||

units.label: Verse 693
units.deva:
यदास्त्युपाधिस् तद्-अभिन्न आत्मा
तदा सजातीय इवावभाति।
स्वप्नार्थतस् तस्य मृषात्मकत्वात्
तदप्रतीतौ स्वयम् एष आत्मा।
ब्रह्मैक्यतामेति पृथङ् न भाति
ततः सजातीय-कृतो न भेदः॥
units.translation: When an adjunct exists, the Self, not different from it, appears as if of the same kind. Since the adjunct is unreal like a dream object, when it is no longer perceived this Self itself attains identity with Brahman and does not appear separate. Therefore there is no difference produced by something of the same kind.
gloss: as if of the same kind
produced by something of the same kind
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yadāstyupādhis tad-abhinna ātmā
tadā sajātīya ivāvabhāti|
svapnārthatas tasya mṛṣātmakatvāt
tadapratītau svayam eṣa ātmā|
brahmaikyatāmeti pṛthaṅ na bhāti
tataḥ sajātīya-kṛto na bhedaḥ||

units.label: Verse 694
units.deva:
घटाभावे घटाकाशो महा-काशो यथा तथा।
उपाध्यभावे त्वात्मैष स्वयं ब्रह्मैव केवलम्॥
units.translation: Just as, when the pot is absent, the space inside it is [seen as] vast space, so when the limiting adjunct is absent this very Self is Brahman alone.
gloss: when the limiting adjunct is absent
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
ghaṭābhāve ghaṭākāśo mahā-kāśo yathā tathā|
upādhyabhāve tvātmaiṣa svayaṃ brahmaiva kevalam||

units.label: Verse 695
units.deva:
पूर्ण एव सदाकाशो घटे सत्यप्यसत्यपि।
नित्य-पूर्णस्य नभसो विच्छेदः केन सिध्यति॥
units.translation: Space is always whole, whether a pot exists or not. By what could the eternally full sky be divided?
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
pūrṇa eva sadākāśo ghaṭe satyapyasatyapi|
nitya-pūrṇasya nabhaso vicchedaḥ kena sidhyati||

units.label: Verse 696
units.deva:
अच्छिन्नश् छिन्नवद् भाति पामराणां घटादिना।
ग्राम-क्षेत्राद्यवधिभिर् भिन्नेव वसुधा यथा॥
units.translation: To ignorant people, undivided space appears divided by a pot and the like, just as the earth seems divided by boundaries such as villages and fields.
gloss: by a pot and the like
by boundaries such as villages and fields
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
acchinnaś chinnavad bhāti pāmarāṇāṃ ghaṭādinā|
grāma-kṣetrādyavadhibhir bhinneva vasudhā yathā||

units.label: Verse 697
units.deva:
तथैव परमं ब्रह्म महतां च महत्तमम्।
परिच्छिन्नम् इवाभाति भ्रान्त्या कल्पित-वस्तुना॥
units.translation: In the same way, supreme Brahman, the greatest of the great, appears limited by an object imagined through delusion.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tathaiva paramaṃ brahma mahatāṃ ca mahattamam|
paricchinnam ivābhāti bhrāntyā kalpita-vastunā||

units.label: Verse 698
units.deva:
तस्माद् ब्रह्मात्मनोर् भेदः कल्पितो न तु वास्तवः।
अत एव मुहुः श्रुत्याप्येकत्वं प्रतिपाद्यते॥
units.translation: Therefore the difference between Brahman and the Self is imagined, not real. For this very reason, Śruti repeatedly teaches their oneness.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tasmād brahmātmanor bhedaḥ kalpito na tu vāstavaḥ|
ata eva muhuḥ śrutyāpyekatvaṃ pratipādyate||

units.label: Verse 699
units.deva:
ब्रह्मात्मनोस् तत् त्वम् असीत्यद्वयत्वोपपत्तये।
प्रत्यक्षादि-विरोधेन वाच्ययोर् नोपयुज्यते।
तत्-त्वम्-पदार्थयोर् ऐक्यं लक्ष्ययोर् एव सिध्यति॥
units.translation: To establish nonduality between Brahman and the Self through “That thou art,” the direct meanings do not work because they conflict with perception and other means of knowledge. The identity of the meanings of “That” and “thou” is established only at the implied level.
gloss: because of conflict with perception and the like
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
brahmātmanos tat tvam asītyadvayatvopapattaye|
pratyakṣādi-virodhena vācyayor nopayujyate|
tat-tvam-padārthayor aikyaṃ lakṣyayor eva sidhyati||

units.label: Verse 700
units.deva:
स्यात् तत्-त्वम्-पदयोः स्वामिन्न् अर्थः कति-विधो मतः।
पदयोः को नु वाच्यार्थो लक्ष्यार्थ उभयोश्च कः॥
units.translation: The disciple asks: Lord, how many kinds of meaning are accepted for the words “That” and “Thou”? What is the direct meaning of each, and what is the implied meaning of both?
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
syāt tat-tvam-padayoḥ svāminn arthaḥ kati-vidho mataḥ|
padayoḥ ko nu vācyārtho lakṣyārtha ubhayośca kaḥ||

units.label: Verse 701
units.deva:
वाच्यैकत्व-विवक्षायां विरोधः कः प्रतीयते।
लक्ष्यार्थयोर् अभिन्नत्वे स कथं विनिवर्तते॥
units.translation: When the direct meanings are intended to be one, what contradiction is perceived? If the implied meanings are not different, how does that contradiction disappear?
gloss: when unity of the direct meanings is intended
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
vācyaikatva-vivakṣāyāṃ virodhaḥ kaḥ pratīyate|
lakṣyārthayor abhinnatve sa kathaṃ vinivartate||

units.label: Verse 702
units.deva:
एकत्व-कथने का वा लक्षणात्रोररी-कृता।
एतत् सर्वं करुणया सम्यक् त्वं प्रतिपादय॥
units.translation: And what interpretation is accepted here in explaining oneness? Explain all this fully and kindly.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
ekatva-kathane kā vā lakṣaṇātrorarī-kṛtā|
etat sarvaṃ karuṇayā samyak tvaṃ pratipādaya||

units.label: Verse 703
units.deva:
शृणुष्वावहितो विद्वन् अद्य ते फलितं तपः।
वाक्यार्थ-श्रुति-मात्रेण सम्यग् ज्ञानं भविष्यति॥
units.translation: Listen attentively, learned one: your austerities have borne fruit today. Clear knowledge will arise simply by hearing the meaning of the sentence.
gloss: simply by hearing the meaning of the sentence
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
śṛṇuṣvāvahito vidvan adya te phalitaṃ tapaḥ|
vākyārtha-śruti-mātreṇa samyag jñānaṃ bhaviṣyati||

units.label: Verse 704
units.deva:
यावन् न तत्-त्वम्-पदयोर् अर्थः सम्यग् विचार्यते।
तावद् एव नृणां बन्धो मृत्यु-संसार-लक्षणः॥
units.translation: As long as the meaning of the words “That” and “Thou” is not carefully examined, people remain bound by bondage characterized by death and saṃsāra.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yāvan na tat-tvam-padayor arthaḥ samyag vicāryate|
tāvad eva nṛṇāṃ bandho mṛtyu-saṃsāra-lakṣaṇaḥ||

units.label: Verse 705
units.deva:
अवस्था सच्-चिद्-आनन्दाखण्डैक-रस-रूपिणी।
मोक्षः सिध्यति वाक्यार्थापरोक्ष-ज्ञानतः सताम्॥
units.translation: For the wise, liberation is attained through direct knowledge of the sentence's meaning, whose nature is the indivisible, single essence of Being, Consciousness, and Bliss.
gloss: having the nature of the indivisible, single essence of Being, Consciousness, and Bliss
through direct knowledge of the sentence's meaning
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
avasthā sac-cid-ānandākhaṇḍaika-rasa-rūpiṇī|
mokṣaḥ sidhyati vākyārthāparokṣa-jñānataḥ satām||

units.label: Verse 706
units.deva:
वाक्यार्थ एव ज्ञातव्यो मुमुक्षोर् भव-मुक्तये।
तस्माद् अवहितो भूत्वा शृणु वक्ष्ये समासतः॥
units.translation: The seeker of liberation should know the sentence's meaning alone in order to be freed from worldly existence. So listen attentively; I shall explain it briefly.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
vākyārtha eva jñātavyo mumukṣor bhava-muktaye|
tasmād avahito bhūtvā śṛṇu vakṣye samāsataḥ||

units.label: Verse 707
units.deva:
अर्था बहु-विधाः प्रोक्ता वाक्यानां पण्डितोत्तमैः।
वाच्य-लक्ष्यादि-भेदेन प्रस्तुतं श्रूयतां त्वया॥
units.translation: The foremost scholars have said that sentences have many meanings, distinguished as direct, implied, and so on. Hear what is being presented to you.
gloss: by distinctions such as direct and implied
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
arthā bahu-vidhāḥ proktā vākyānāṃ paṇḍitottamaiḥ|
vācya-lakṣyādi-bhedena prastutaṃ śrūyatāṃ tvayā||

units.label: Verse 708
units.deva:
वाक्ये तत् त्वम् असीत्यत्र विद्यते यत् पद-त्रयम्।
तत्रादौ विद्यमानस्य तत्-पदस्य निगद्यते॥
units.translation: In the sentence “That thou art,” there are these three words. First, the meaning of the word “That,” which occurs at the beginning, is stated.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
vākye tat tvam asītyatra vidyate yat pada-trayam|
tatrādau vidyamānasya tat-padasya nigadyate||

units.label: Verse 709
units.deva:
शास्त्रार्थ-कोविदैर् अर्थो वाच्यो लक्ष्य इति द्विधा।
वाच्यार्थं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि पण्डितैर् य उदीरितः॥
units.translation: Those who know the meaning of scripture say that meaning is twofold: direct and implied. I shall explain to you the direct meaning stated by the learned.
gloss: by those learned in scriptural meaning
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
śāstrārtha-kovidair artho vācyo lakṣya iti dvidhā|
vācyārthaṃ te pravakṣyāmi paṇḍitair ya udīritaḥ||

units.label: Verse 710
units.deva:
समष्टि-रूपम् अज्ञानं साभासं सत्त्व-बृंहितम्।
वियद्-आदि-विराड्-अन्तं स्व-कार्येण समन्वितम्॥
units.translation: The collective form of ignorance, accompanied by a reflection [of consciousness] and strengthened by sattva, extends from space to Virāṭ and is joined with its own effects.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
samaṣṭi-rūpam ajñānaṃ sābhāsaṃ sattva-bṛṃhitam|
viyad-ādi-virāḍ-antaṃ sva-kāryeṇa samanvitam||

units.label: Verse 711
units.deva:
चैतन्यं तदवच्छिन्नं सत्य-ज्ञानादि-लक्षणम्।
सर्वज्ञत्वेश्वरत्वान्तर्यामित्वादि-गुणैर् युतम्॥
units.translation: Consciousness limited by that [ignorance], characterized by truth, knowledge, and the like, and endowed with qualities such as omniscience, lordship, and being the inner controller.
gloss: characterized by truth, knowledge, and the like
with qualities such as omniscience, lordship, and inner-controllerhood
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
caitanyaṃ tadavacchinnaṃ satya-jñānādi-lakṣaṇam|
sarvajñatveśvaratvāntaryāmitvādi-guṇair yutam||

units.label: Verse 712
units.deva:
जगत्-स्रष्टृत्व-पातृत्व-संहर्तृत्वादि-धर्मकम्।
सर्वात्मना भासमानं यदमेयं गुणैश्च तत्॥
units.translation: That [Lord] has attributes such as creating, protecting, and dissolving the world; it appears as everything, is immeasurable, and is endowed with qualities.
gloss: having attributes such as creating, protecting, and dissolving the world
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
jagat-sraṣṭṛtva-pātṛtva-saṃhartṛtvādi-dharmakam|
sarvātmanā bhāsamānaṃ yadameyaṃ guṇaiśca tat||

units.label: Verse 713
units.deva:
अव्यक्तम् अपरं ब्रह्म वाच्यार्थ इति कथ्यते।
नीलम् उत्पलम् इत्यत्र यथा वाक्यार्थ-सङ्गतिः॥
units.translation: The unmanifest, transcendent Brahman is said to be the direct meaning [of “That”], just as there is a sentence relation in the phrase “blue lotus.”
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
avyaktam aparaṃ brahma vācyārtha iti kathyate|
nīlam utpalam ityatra yathā vākyārtha-saṅgatiḥ||

units.label: Verse 714
units.deva:
तथा तत् त्वम् असीत्यत्र नास्ति वाक्यार्थ-सङ्गतिः।
पटाद् व्यावर्तते नील उत्पलेन विशेषितः॥
units.translation: Likewise, “That thou art” does not form a coherent sentence relation [at the direct level]. A blue [thing], qualified as a lotus, is distinguished from a cloth.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tathā tat tvam asītyatra nāsti vākyārtha-saṅgatiḥ|
paṭād vyāvartate nīla utpalena viśeṣitaḥ||

units.label: Verse 715
units.deva:
शौक्ल्याद् व्यावर्तते नीलेनोत्पलं तु विशेषितम्।
इत्थम् अन्योन्य-भेदस्य व्यावर्तकतया तयोः॥
units.translation: A lotus qualified as blue is distinguished from whiteness. In this way, the two exclude what differs from each other.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
śauklyād vyāvartate nīlenotpalaṃ tu viśeṣitam|
ittham anyonya-bhedasya vyāvartakatayā tayoḥ||

units.label: Verse 716
units.deva:
विशेषण-विशेष्यत्व-संसर्गस्येतरस्य वा।
वाक्यार्थत्वे प्रमाणान्तर-विरोधो न विद्यते॥
units.translation: Whether the sentence meaning consists in a relation of qualifier and qualified or in some other relation, there is no conflict with another means of knowledge.
gloss: of a relation between qualifier and qualified
when it is the sentence meaning
conflict with another means of knowledge
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
viśeṣaṇa-viśeṣyatva-saṃsargasyetarasya vā|
vākyārthatve pramāṇāntara-virodho na vidyate||

units.label: Verse 717
units.deva:
अतः सङ्गच्छते सम्यग् वाक्यार्थो बाध-वर्जितः।
एवं तत् त्वम् असीत्यत्र वाक्यार्थो न समञ्जसः॥
units.translation: Thus the sentence meaning fits properly, free from contradiction. But in “That thou art,” the sentence meaning does not fit [at the direct level].
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
ataḥ saṅgacchate samyag vākyārtho bādha-varjitaḥ|
evaṃ tat tvam asītyatra vākyārtho na samañjasaḥ||

units.label: Verse 718
units.deva:
तद्-अर्थस्य परोक्षत्वादि-विशिष्ट-चितेर् अपि।
त्वम्-अर्थस्यापरोक्षत्वादि-विशिष्ट-चितेर् अपि॥
units.translation: The meaning of “That” is consciousness qualified by remoteness and the like, while the meaning of “Thou” is consciousness qualified by immediacy and the like.
gloss: of consciousness qualified by remoteness and the like
of consciousness qualified by immediacy and the like
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tad-arthasya parokṣatvādi-viśiṣṭa-citer api|
tvam-arthasyāparokṣatvādi-viśiṣṭa-citer api||

units.label: Verse 719
units.deva:
तथैवान्योन्य-भेदस्य व्यावर्तकतया तयोः।
विशेषण-विशेष्यस्य संसर्गस्येतरस्य वा॥
units.translation: The two appear to relate by excluding their mutual difference, through a relation of qualifier and qualified or some other relation.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tathaivānyonya-bhedasya vyāvartakatayā tayoḥ|
viśeṣaṇa-viśeṣyasya saṃsargasyetarasya vā||

units.label: Verse 720
units.deva:
वाक्यार्थत्वे विरोधोऽस्ति प्रत्यक्षादि-कृतस् ततः।
सङ्गच्छते न वाक्यार्थस् तद् विरोधं च वच्मि ते॥
units.translation: Even then there is a contradiction in the sentence meaning, caused by perception and the like; therefore the meaning does not fit. I shall explain that contradiction to you.
gloss: caused by perception and the like
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
vākyārthatve virodho’sti pratyakṣādi-kṛtas tataḥ|
saṅgacchate na vākyārthas tad virodhaṃ ca vacmi te||

units.label: Verse 721
units.deva:
सर्वेशत्व-स्व-तन्त्रत्व-सर्वज्ञत्वादिभिर् गुणैः।
सर्वोत्तमः सत्य-कामः सत्य-सङ्कल्प ईश्वरः॥
units.translation: The Lord is supreme among all, independent, and endowed with qualities such as omniscience; his desires are fulfilled and his resolve is true.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
sarveśatva-sva-tantratva-sarvajñatvādibhir guṇaiḥ|
sarvottamaḥ satya-kāmaḥ satya-saṅkalpa īśvaraḥ||

units.label: Verse 722
units.deva:
तत्-पदार्थस् त्वम्-अर्थस्तु किञ्चिज्-ज्ञो दुःख-जीवनः।
संसार्ययं तद्-गतिको जीवः प्राकृत-लक्षणः॥
units.translation: The meaning of “That” differs from the meaning of “Thou”: the individual soul knows little, lives in sorrow, wanders in saṃsāra, follows its course, and is characterized by material nature.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tat-padārthas tvam-arthastu kiñcij-jño duḥkha-jīvanaḥ|
saṃsāryayaṃ tad-gatiko jīvaḥ prākṛta-lakṣaṇaḥ||

units.label: Verse 723
units.deva:
कथम् एकत्वम् अनयोर् घटते विपरीतयोः।
प्रत्यक्षेण विरोधोऽयम् उभयोर् उपलभ्यते॥
units.translation: How can these two opposites be one? Their contradiction is directly perceived.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
katham ekatvam anayor ghaṭate viparītayoḥ|
pratyakṣeṇa virodho’yam ubhayor upalabhyate||

units.label: Verse 724
units.deva:
विरुद्ध-धर्माक्रान्ततत्वात् परस्-पर-विलक्षणौ।
जीवेशौ वह्नि-तुहिनाव् इव शब्दार्थतोऽपि च॥
units.translation: Because they are beset by opposite properties, the individual soul and the Lord are unlike each other, even in the direct meanings of the words—like fire and snow.
gloss: because they are beset by opposite properties
the individual soul and the Lord
in the direct meaning of the words
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
viruddha-dharmākrāntatatvāt paras-para-vilakṣaṇau|
jīveśau vahni-tuhināv iva śabdārthato’pi ca||

units.label: Verse 725
units.deva:
प्रत्यक्षादि-विरोधः स्याद् इत्यैक्ये तयोः परित्यक्ते।
श्रुति-वचन-विरोधो भवति महान् स्मृति-वचन-विरोधश्च॥
units.translation: If their unity is rejected on the grounds that it conflicts with perception and the like, a great contradiction with the statements of Śruti and Smṛti follows.
gloss: conflict with perception and the like
conflict with the words of Śruti
conflict with the words of Smṛti
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
pratyakṣādi-virodhaḥ syād ityaikye tayoḥ parityakte|
śruti-vacana-virodho bhavati mahān smṛti-vacana-virodhaśca||

units.label: Verse 726
units.deva:
श्रुत्याप्येकत्वम् अनयोस् तात्पर्येण निगद्यते।
मुहुस् तत् त्वम् असीत्यस्माद् अङ्गी-कार्यं श्रुतेर् वचः॥
units.translation: Śruti declares the oneness of these two as its intended teaching, repeatedly saying “That thou art.” Therefore, the words of Śruti must be accepted.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
śrutyāpyekatvam anayos tātparyeṇa nigadyate|
muhus tat tvam asītyasmād aṅgī-kāryaṃ śruter vacaḥ||

units.label: Verse 727
units.deva:
वाक्यार्थत्वे विशिष्टस्य संसर्गस्य च वा पुनः।
अयथार्थतया सोऽयं वाक्यार्थो न मतः श्रुतेः॥
units.translation: A relation between qualified meanings, or some other relation, is not the sentence meaning intended by Śruti, because such a meaning is not true to what is meant.
gloss: because it is not true to the intended meaning
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
vākyārthatve viśiṣṭasya saṃsargasya ca vā punaḥ|
ayathārthatayā so’yaṃ vākyārtho na mataḥ śruteḥ||

units.label: Verse 728
units.deva:
अखण्डैक-रसत्वेन वाक्यार्थः श्रुति-सम्मतः।
स्थूल-सूक्ष्म-प्रपञ्चस्य सन्मात्रत्वं पुनः पुनः॥
units.translation: Śruti accepts the sentence meaning as one indivisible essence: again and again it teaches that the gross and subtle world is nothing but Being.
gloss: of the gross and subtle world
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
akhaṇḍaika-rasatvena vākyārthaḥ śruti-sammataḥ|
sthūla-sūkṣma-prapañcasya sanmātratvaṃ punaḥ punaḥ||

units.label: Verse 729
units.deva:
दर्शयित्वा सुषुप्तौ तद्-ब्रह्माभिन्नत्वम् आत्मनः।
उपपाद्य सदैकत्वं प्रदर्शयितुम् इच्छया॥
units.translation: By showing in deep sleep that the Self is not different from that Brahman, and by establishing their constant oneness, [Śruti speaks] with the intention of demonstrating this.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
darśayitvā suṣuptau tad-brahmābhinnatvam ātmanaḥ|
upapādya sadaikatvaṃ pradarśayitum icchayā||

units.label: Verse 730
units.deva:
ऐतदात्म्यम् इदं सर्वम् इत्युक्त्वैव सदात्मनोः।
ब्रवीति श्रुतिरेकत्वं ब्रह्मणोऽद्वैतसिद्धये॥
units.translation: Having said, “All this has That as its Self,” Śruti declares the oneness of Being and the Self, to establish Brahman's nonduality.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
aitadātmyam idaṃ sarvam ityuktvaiva sadātmanoḥ|
bravīti śrutir ekatvaṃ brahmaṇo’dvaita-siddhaye||

units.label: Verse 731
units.deva:
सति प्रपञ्चे जीवे वाद्वैतत्वं ब्रह्मणः कुतः।
अतस् तयोर् अखण्डत्वम् एकत्वं श्रुति-सम्मतम्॥
units.translation: If the world and individual souls exist [as separate realities], how could Brahman be nondual? Therefore Śruti teaches the indivisibility and oneness of them.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
sati prapañce jīve vādvaitatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kutaḥ|
atas tayor akhaṇḍatvam ekatvaṃ śruti-sammatam||

units.label: Verse 732
units.deva:
विरुद्धांश-परित्यागात् प्रत्यक्षादिर् न बाधते।
अविरुद्धांश-ग्रहणान् न श्रुत्यापि विरुध्यते॥
units.translation: By giving up the contradictory aspects, perception and the like do not invalidate the meaning; by taking up the non-contradictory aspects, it does not conflict with Śruti either.
gloss: by giving up the contradictory aspects
by taking up the non-contradictory aspects
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
viruddhāṃśa-parityāgāt pratyakṣādir na bādhate|
aviruddhāṃśa-grahaṇān na śrutyāpi virudhyate||

units.label: Verse 733
units.deva:
लक्षणा ह्युपगन्तव्या ततो वाक्यार्थ-सिद्धये।
वाच्यार्थानुपपत्त्यैव लक्षणाभ्युपगम्यते॥
units.translation: Therefore, an implied indication must be accepted to establish the sentence meaning; such indication is accepted precisely when the direct meaning does not fit.
gloss: precisely because the direct meaning does not fit
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
lakṣaṇā hyupagantavyā tato vākyārtha-siddhaye|
vācyārthānupapattyaiva lakṣaṇābhyupagamyate||

units.label: Verse 734
units.deva:
सम्बन्धानुपपत्त्या च लक्षणेति जगुर् बुधाः।
गङ्गायां घोष इत्यादौ या जहल्-लक्षणा मता॥
units.translation: The wise call it implied indication when the connection does not fit. In expressions such as “a cowherd settlement in the Ganges,” the accepted type is total relinquishment of the direct meaning.
gloss: when the connection does not fit
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
sambandhānupapattyā ca lakṣaṇeti jagur budhāḥ|
gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādau yā jahal-lakṣaṇā matā||

units.label: Verse 735
units.deva:
न सा तत् त्वम् असीत्यत्र वाक्य एषा प्रवर्तते।
गङ्गाया अपि घोषस्याधाराधेयत्व-लक्षणम्॥
units.translation: That type does not operate in the sentence “That thou art.” In “a cowherd settlement in the Ganges,” there is instead a relation of support and supported between the Ganges and the settlement.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
na sā tat tvam asītyatra vākya eṣā pravartate|
gaṅgāyā api ghoṣasyādhārādheyatva-lakṣaṇam||

units.label: Verse 736
units.deva:
सर्वो विरुद्ध-वाक्यार्थस् तत्र प्रत्यक्षतस् ततः।
गङ्गा-सम्बन्धवत्-तीरे लक्षणा सम्प्रवर्तते॥
units.translation: There, the whole direct sentence meaning conflicts with perception. Therefore, implied indication shifts to the bank that is connected with the Ganges.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
sarvo viruddha-vākyārthas tatra pratyakṣatas tataḥ|
gaṅgā-sambandhavat-tīre lakṣaṇā sampravartate||

units.label: Verse 737
units.deva:
तथा तत् त्वम् असीत्यत्र चैतन्यैकत्व-लक्षणे।
विवक्षिते तु वाक्यार्थेऽपरोक्षत्वादि-लक्षणः॥
units.translation: Likewise, in “That thou art,” what is intended is oneness of consciousness, with the sentence meaning characterized by immediacy and the like.
gloss: where oneness of consciousness is intended
characterized by immediacy and the like
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tathā tat tvam asītyatra caitanyaikatva-lakṣaṇe|
vivakṣite tu vākyārthe’parokṣatvādi-lakṣaṇaḥ||

units.label: Verse 738
units.deva:
विरुध्यते भाग-मात्रो न तु सर्वो विरुध्यते।
तस्माज् जहल्-लक्षणायाः प्रवृत्तिर् नात्र युज्यते॥
units.translation: Only one part is contradictory; the whole is not contradictory. Therefore, total relinquishment of the direct meaning is not appropriate here.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
virudhyate bhāga-mātro na tu sarvo virudhyate|
tasmāj jahal-lakṣaṇāyāḥ pravṛttir nātra yujyate||

units.label: Verse 739
units.deva:
वाच्यार्थस्य तु सर्वस्य त्यागे न फलम् ईक्ष्यते।
नालिकेर-फलस्येव कठिनत्व-धिया नृणाम्॥
units.translation: There is no benefit in abandoning the entire direct meaning; people still associate a coconut fruit with hardness.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
vācyārthasya tu sarvasya tyāge na phalam īkṣyate|
nālikera-phalasyeva kaṭhinatva-dhiyā nṛṇām||

units.label: Verse 740
units.deva:
गङ्गा-पदं यथा स्वार्थं त्यक्त्वा लक्षयते तटम्।
तत्-पदं त्वम्-पदं वापि त्यक्त्वा स्वार्थं यथाखिलम्॥
units.translation: Just as the word “Ganges” gives up its own direct meaning and indicates the bank, so the word “That” or “Thou” may give up its entire direct meaning [to indicate something related].
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
gaṅgā-padaṃ yathā svārthaṃ tyaktvā lakṣayate taṭam|
tat-padaṃ tvam-padaṃ vāpi tyaktvā svārthaṃ yathākhilam||

units.label: Verse 741
units.deva:
तद्-अर्थं वा त्वम्-अर्थं वा यदि लक्षयति स्वयम्।
तदा जहल्-लक्षणायाः प्रवृत्तिर् उपपद्यते॥
units.translation: If the word itself indicates either the meaning of “That” or the meaning of “Thou,” then total-relinquishment indication applies.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tad-arthaṃ vā tvam-arthaṃ vā yadi lakṣayati svayam|
tadā jahal-lakṣaṇāyāḥ pravṛttir upapadyate||

units.label: Verse 742
units.deva:
न शङ्कनीयम् इत्यार्यैर् ज्ञातार्थे न हि लक्षणा।
तत्-पदं त्वम्-पदं वापि श्रूयते च प्रतीयते॥
units.translation: One should not object, “The meaning is already known, so no indication is needed.” The words “That” and “Thou” are heard and understood [in the sentence].
gloss: to be doubted or objected to
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
na śaṅkanīyam ityāryair jñātārthe na hi lakṣaṇā|
tat-padaṃ tvam-padaṃ vāpi śrūyate ca pratīyate||

units.label: Verse 743
units.deva:
तदर्थे च कथं तत्र सम्प्रवर्तेत लक्षणा।
अत्र शोणो धावतीति वाक्यवन् न प्रवर्तते॥
units.translation: How, then, could implied indication operate there for that meaning? It does not operate as in the sentence “The red [one] runs.”
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tadarthe ca kathaṃ tatra sampravarteta lakṣaṇā|
atra śoṇo dhāvatīti vākyavan na pravartate||

units.label: Verse 744
units.deva:
अजहल्-लक्षणा वापि सा जहल्-लक्षणा यथा।
गुणस्य गमनं लोके विरुद्धं द्रव्यम् अन्तरा॥
units.translation: That is the type of indication that retains the direct meaning; in ordinary speech a quality cannot move without a substance.
gloss: indication that does not abandon the direct meaning
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
ajahal-lakṣaṇā vāpi sā jahal-lakṣaṇā yathā|
guṇasya gamanaṃ loke viruddhaṃ dravyam antarā||

units.label: Verse 745
units.deva:
अतस् तम् अपरित्यज्य तद्-गुणाश्रय-लक्षणः।
लक्ष्यादिर् लक्ष्यते तत्र लक्षणासौ प्रवर्तते॥
units.translation: Therefore, without discarding the quality, the thing that supports it is indicated; that is how implied indication operates.
gloss: characterized by being the support of that quality
the indicated referent and the rest
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
atas tam aparityajya tad-guṇāśraya-lakṣaṇaḥ|
lakṣyādir lakṣyate tatra lakṣaṇāsau pravartate||

units.label: Verse 746
units.deva:
वाक्ये तत् त्वम् असीत्यत्र ब्रह्मात्मैकत्व-बोधके।
परोक्षत्वापरोक्षत्वादि-विशिष्ट-चितोर् द्वयोः॥
units.translation: In the sentence “That thou art,” which teaches the identity of Brahman and the Self, [the expression concerns] two consciousnesses qualified by remoteness, immediacy, and the like.
gloss: which teaches the identity of Brahman and the Self
of consciousnesses qualified by remoteness, immediacy, and the like
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
vākye tat tvam asītyatra brahmātmaikatva-bodhake|
parokṣatvāparokṣatvādi-viśiṣṭa-citor dvayoḥ||

units.label: Verse 747
units.deva:
एकत्व-रूप-वाक्यार्थो विरुद्धांश-विवर्जनात्।
न सिध्यति यतस् तस्मान् नाजहल्-लक्षणा मता॥
units.translation: Since a sentence meaning in the form of oneness is not established by removing the conflicting parts [alone], total non-relinquishment of the direct meaning is not accepted.
gloss: a sentence meaning in the form of oneness
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
ekatva-rūpa-vākyārtho viruddhāṃśa-vivarjanāt|
na sidhyati yatas tasmān nājahal-lakṣaṇā matā||

units.label: Verse 748
units.deva:
तत्-पदं त्वम्-पदं चापि स्वकीयार्थ-विरोधिनम्।
अंशं सम्यक् परित्यज्य स्वाविरुद्धांश-संयुतम्॥
units.translation: The words “That” and “Thou” each give up precisely the part of their own meaning that conflicts with the other, retaining the part that does not conflict.
gloss: that which conflicts with its own meaning
joined with its own non-conflicting part
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tat-padaṃ tvam-padaṃ cāpi svakīyārtha-virodhinam|
aṃśaṃ samyak parityajya svāviruddhāṃśa-saṃyutam||

units.label: Verse 749
units.deva:
तद्-अर्थं वा त्वम्-अर्थं वा सम्यग् लक्षयतः स्वयम्।
भाग-लक्षणया साध्यं किम् अस्तीति न शङ्क्यताम्॥
units.translation: Do not ask what is accomplished by part-indication when one accurately indicates the meaning of either “That” or “Thou” itself.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tad-arthaṃ vā tvam-arthaṃ vā samyag lakṣayataḥ svayam|
bhāga-lakṣaṇayā sādhyaṃ kim astīti na śaṅkyatām||

units.label: Verse 750
units.deva:
अविरुद्धं पदार्थान्तरांशं स्वांशं च तत् कथम्।
एकं पदं लक्षणया संलक्षयितुम् अर्हति॥
units.translation: How can one word, through implication, indicate both the non-conflicting part of another word's meaning and its own part?
gloss: a part of another word's meaning
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
aviruddhaṃ padārthāntarāṃśaṃ svāṃśaṃ ca tat katham|
ekaṃ padaṃ lakṣaṇayā saṃlakṣayitum arhati||

units.label: Verse 751
units.deva:
पदान्तरेण सिद्धायां पदार्थ-प्रमितौ स्वतः।
तद्-अर्थ-प्रत्ययापेक्षा पुनर् लक्षणया कुतः॥
units.translation: When the meaning of an object is already established on its own through another word, why should understanding that meaning again depend on implication?
gloss: in the understanding of the object
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
padāntareṇa siddhāyāṃ padārtha-pramitau svataḥ|
tad-artha-pratyayāpekṣā punar lakṣaṇayā kutaḥ||

units.label: Verse 752
units.deva:
तस्मात् तत् त्वम् असीत्यत्र लक्षणा भाग-लक्षणा।
वाक्यार्थ-सत्त्वाखण्डैक-रसता-सिद्धये मता॥
units.translation: Therefore, in “That thou art,” the indication is part-indication, intended to establish the sentence meaning as an indivisible, single essence.
gloss: to establish the sentence meaning as an indivisible, single essence
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tasmāt tat tvam asītyatra lakṣaṇā bhāga-lakṣaṇā|
vākyārtha-sattvākhaṇḍaika-rasatā-siddhaye matā||

units.label: Verse 753
units.deva:
भागं विरुद्धं सन्त्यज्याविरोधो लक्ष्यते यदा।
सा भाग-लक्षणेत्याहुर् लक्षण-ज्ञा विचक्षणाः॥
units.translation: When the conflicting part is given up and the non-conflicting meaning is indicated, the discerning knowers of implication call that part-indication.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
bhāgaṃ viruddhaṃ santyajyāvirodho lakṣyate yadā|
sā bhāga-lakṣaṇetyāhur lakṣaṇa-jñā vicakṣaṇāḥ||

units.label: Verse 754
units.deva:
सोऽयं देव-दत्त इति वाक्यं वाक्यार्थ एव वा।
देव-दत्तैक्य-रूप-स्ववाक्यार्थानवबोधकम्॥
units.translation: For example, in “That is this Devadatta,” looking at the whole sentence reveals that both references are one and the same Devadatta.
gloss: having the form of Devadatta's identity
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
so’yaṃ deva-datta iti vākyaṃ vākyārtha eva vā|
deva-dattaikya-rūpa-svavākyārthānavabodhakam||

units.label: Verse 755
units.deva:
देश-कालादि-वैशिष्ट्यं विरुद्धांशं निरस्य च।
अविरुद्धं देवदत्त-देह-मात्रं स्व-लक्षणम्॥
units.translation: After setting aside the conflicting features of place, time, and the like, what remains is the non-conflicting identifying feature: Devadatta himself.
gloss: features of place, time, and the like
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
deśa-kālādi-vaiśiṣṭyaṃ viruddhāṃśaṃ nirasya ca|
aviruddhaṃ devadatta-deha-mātraṃ sva-lakṣaṇam||

units.label: Verse 756
units.deva:
भाग-लक्षणया सम्यग् लक्षयत्यनया यथा।
तथा तत् त्वम् असीत्यत्र वाक्यं वाक्यार्थ एव वा॥
units.translation: Just as this example correctly indicates identity through part-indication, so too the sentence “That thou art,” and its meaning, [indicates identity].
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
bhāga-lakṣaṇayā samyag lakṣayatyanayā yathā|
tathā tat tvam asītyatra vākyaṃ vākyārtha eva vā||

units.label: Verse 757
units.deva:
परोक्षत्वापरोक्षत्वादि-विशिष्ट-चितोर् द्वयोः।
एकत्व-रूप-वाक्यार्थ-विरुद्धांशम् उपस्थितम्॥
units.translation: In the two consciousnesses qualified by remoteness, immediacy, and the like, the conflicting part is present in the sentence meaning that expresses oneness.
gloss: of the two consciousnesses qualified by remoteness, immediacy, and the like
in the sentence meaning expressing oneness
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
parokṣatvāparokṣatvādi-viśiṣṭa-citor dvayoḥ|
ekatva-rūpa-vākyārtha-viruddhāṃśam upasthitam||

units.label: Verse 758
units.deva:
परोक्षत्वापरोक्षत्व-सर्वज्ञत्वादि-लक्षणम्।
बुद्ध्यादि-स्थूल-पर्यन्तम् आविद्यकम् अनात्मकम्॥
units.translation: Features such as remoteness, immediacy, and omniscience, and everything from the intellect down to the gross body, arise from ignorance and are not the Self.
gloss: characterized by omniscience and the like
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
parokṣatvāparokṣatva-sarvajñatvādi-lakṣaṇam|
buddhyādi-sthūla-paryantam āvidyakam anātmakam||

units.label: Verse 759
units.deva:
परित्यज्य विरुद्धांशं शुद्ध-चैतन्य-लक्षणम्।
वस्तु केवल-सन्मात्रं निर्विकल्पं निरञ्जनम्॥
units.translation: Having abandoned the conflicting part, the Reality is characterized by pure consciousness: Being alone, free from distinctions, and stainless.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
parityajya viruddhāṃśaṃ śuddha-caitanya-lakṣaṇam|
vastu kevala-sanmātraṃ nirvikalpaṃ nirañjanam||

units.label: Verse 760
units.deva:
लक्षयत्यनया सम्यग् भाग-लक्षणया ततः।
सर्वोपाधि-विनिर्मुक्तं सच्-चिद्-आनन्दम् अद्वयम्॥
units.translation: By this part-indication one correctly indicates [Brahman] as free from every limiting adjunct, nondual, and of the nature of Being, Consciousness, and Bliss.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
lakṣayaty anayā samyag bhāga-lakṣaṇayā tataḥ|
sarvopādhi-vinirmuktaṃ sac-cid-ānandam advayam||

units.label: Verse 761
units.deva:
निर्विशेषं निराभासम् अतादृशम् अनीदृशम्।
अनिर्देश्यम् अनाद्यन्तम् अनन्तं शान्तम् अच्युतम्।
अप्रतर्क्यम् अविज्ञेयं निर्गुणं ब्रह्म शिष्यते॥
units.translation: Inasmuch as Brahman is not an object of thought. It is devoid of all attributes, and transcending all verbal definition. Tranquil in itself, It is without beginning or end; It is infinite in nature, subject to no modification, incomprehensible by means of reasoning, transcending thought and the reach of sense-knowledge.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
nirviśeṣaṃ nirābhāsam atādṛśam anīdṛśam|
anirdeśyam anādyantam anantaṃ śāntam acyutam|
apratarkyam avijñeyaṃ nirguṇaṃ brahma śiṣyate||

units.label: Verse 762
units.deva:
उपाधि-वैशिष्ट्य-कृतो विरोधो
ब्रह्मात्मनोर् एकतयाधिगत्या।
उपाधि-वैशिष्ट्य उदस्यमाने
न कश्चिद् अप्यस्ति विरोध एतयोः॥
units.translation: As long as the limiting adjuncts intervene, there remains the hindrance to the perception of the unity of Ātman and Brahman. But when once the intervening adjuncts are discarded as unreal, all contradictions are resolved and the ultimate unity is established.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
upādhi-vaiśiṣṭya-kṛto virodho
brahmātmanor ekatayādhigatyā|
upādhi-vaiśiṣṭya udasyamāne
na kaścid apyasti virodha etayoḥ||

units.label: Verse 763
units.deva:
तयोर् उपाधिश्च विशिष्टता च
तद्-धर्म-भाक्त्वं च विलक्षणत्वम्।
भ्रान्त्या कृतं सर्वम् इदं मृषैव
स्वप्नार्थवज् जाग्रति नैव सत्यम्॥
units.translation: Examination therefore reveals to us that all these adjuncts or upādhis and their characteristics, which alone are the source of all separateness, are entirely unreal. They are but the products of the delusion of the intellect. They have no being; and they do fade away like the objects of the dream world when waking intervenes.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tayor upādhiśca viśiṣṭatā ca
tad-dharma-bhāktvaṃ ca vilakṣaṇatvam|
bhrāntyā kṛtaṃ sarvam idaṃ mṛṣaiva
svapnārthavaj jāgrati naiva satyam||

units.label: Verse 764
units.deva:
निद्रा-सूत-शरीर-धर्म-सुख-दुःखादि-प्रपञ्चोऽपि वा
जीवेशादि-भिदापि वा न च ऋतं कर्तुं क्वचिच् छक्यते।
माया-कल्पित-देश-काल-जगद्-ईशादि-भ्रमस् तादृशः
को भेदोऽस्त्यनयोर् द्वयोस् तु कतमः सत्योऽन्यतः को भवेत्॥
units.translation: In the midst of a dream one feels as though one were invested with a dream body. One seems to have dream children, and experiences peculiar pleasures and pains. One may even perceive that there is a difference between the individual and Īśvara. But none of these can make the dream real. In the same way the delusion of time and space, of the universe and Īśvara which are the products of Māyā, should be deemed to be unreal. Inasmuch as waking and dreaming are correlative, if one of them is unreal, what is the guarantee that the other also is not unreal?
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
nidrā-sūta-śarīra-dharma-sukha-duḥkhādi-prapañco’pi vā
jīveśādi-bhidāpi vā na ca ṛtaṃ kartuṃ kvacic chakyate|
māyā-kalpita-deśa-kāla-jagad-īśādi-bhramas tādṛśaḥ
ko bhedo’styanayor dvayos tu katamaḥ satyo’nyataḥ ko bhavet||

units.label: Verse 765
units.deva:
न स्वप्न-जागरणयोर् उभयोर् विशेषः
सन्दृश्यते क्वचिद् अपि भ्रमजैर् विकल्पैः।
यद् दृष्ट-दर्शन-मुखैर् अत एव मिथ्या
स्वप्नो यथा ननु तथैव हि जागरोऽपि॥
units.translation: Both waking and dreaming are subject to the illusion which the intellect imposes upon us. In this respect, there is no difference between them. In both these levels of consciousness, there is the triune distinction among the knower, the known and the means of knowing. Therefore the waking moment is also as unreal as a dream.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
na svapna-jāgaraṇayor ubhayor viśeṣaḥ
sandṛśyate kvacid api bhramajair vikalpaiḥ|
yad dṛṣṭa-darśana-mukhair ata eva mithyā
svapno yathā nanu tathaiva hi jāgaro’pi||

units.label: Verse 766
units.deva:
अविद्या-कार्यतस् तुल्यौ द्वावपि स्वप्न-जागरौ।
दृष्ट-दर्शन-दृश्यादि-कल्पनोभयतः समा॥
units.translation: Inasmuch as both these levels of consciousness are the products of our ignorance, in this respect also they are on a par. That is why, in both these states of awareness, the triple distinction among the seer, the seen, and the process of seeing should be regarded as being unreal.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
avidyā-kāryatas tulyau dvāvapi svapna-jāgarau|
dṛṣṭa-darśana-dṛśyādi-kalpanobhayataḥ samā||

units.label: Verse 767
units.deva:
अभाव उभयोः सुप्तौ सर्वैर् अप्यनुभूयते।
न कश्चिद् अनयोर् भेदस् तस्मान् मिथ्यात्वम् अर्हतः॥
units.translation: Every one knows how in deep sleep, both waking and dreaming cease to exist. In this respect also there is a similarity between the two. Therefore both these levels of consciousness should be regarded as being unreal.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
abhāva ubhayoḥ suptau sarvair apyanubhūyate|
na kaścid anayor bhedas tasmān mithyātvam arhataḥ||

units.label: Verse 768
units.deva:
भ्रान्त्या ब्रह्मणि भेदोऽयं सजातीयादि-लक्षणः।
काल-त्रयेऽपि हे विद्वन् वस्तुतो नैव कश्चन॥
units.translation: Whether these seeming distinctions that are perceived are among the objects of the same class or whether they are among objects of different categories they should all be regarded as unreal; they have no being in Brahman. They are the outcome of illusion. 0 learned one, in the ultimate Reality there can be no difference either, in the past, or the present or the future.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
bhrāntyā brahmaṇi bhedo’yaṃ sajātīyādi-lakṣaṇaḥ|
kāla-traye’pi he vidvan vastuto naiva kaścana||

units.label: Verse 769
units.deva:
यत्र नान्यत् पश्यतीति श्रुतिर् द्वैतं निषेधति।
कल्पितस्य भ्रमाद् भूम्नि मिथ्यात्वावगमाय तत्॥
units.translation: Therefore, when the Śruti refers to That in which one perceives any difference whatsoever, it discountenances all such concepts of duality. In this way it removes all that is unreal and which has been superimposed through ignorance upon what is the all-pervading principle. ((ChanU.7.24.1) (Chāndogya Upaniṣad))
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yatra nānyat paśyatīti śrutir dvaitaṃ niṣedhati|
kalpitasya bhramād bhūmni mithyātvāvagamāya tat||

units.label: Verse 770
units.deva:
यतस् ततो ब्रह्म सदाद्वितीयं
विकल्प-शून्यं निरुपाधि निर्मलम्।
निरन्तरानन्द-घनं निरीहं
निरास्पदं केवलम् एकम् एव॥
units.translation: The absolute Brahman is ever-existent, non-dual, and subject to no kind of change. It is devoid of adjuncts, is not affected by anything, and is not subject to anything. Brahman is pure and is of the nature of bliss. As there is nothing lacking for Brahman, there is nothing to be achieved which would fill the want. Therefore Brahman is not a means to an end; it is ever the one non-dual Reality.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yatas tato brahma sadādvitīyaṃ
vikalpa-śūnyaṃ nirupādhi nirmalam|
nirantarānanda-ghanaṃ nirīhaṃ
nirāspadaṃ kevalam ekam eva||

units.label: Verse 771
units.deva:
नैवास्ति काचन भिदा न गुण-प्रतीतिर्
नो वाक्-प्रवृत्तिर् अपि वा न मनः-प्रवृत्तिः।
यत् केवलं परम-शान्तम् अनन्तम् आद्यम्
आनन्द-मात्रम् अवभाति सद् अद्वितीयम्॥
units.translation: Brahman knows no distinction within itself, and is beyond the triune qualities of sattva, rajas and tamas. Neither by means of the mind, nor by means of words could Brahman be comprehended. Brahman is pure, supremely tranquil, infinite, primal, resplendent in bliss, and is ever the One without a second.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
naivāsti kācana bhidā na guṇa-pratītir
no vāk-pravṛttir api vā na manaḥ-pravṛttiḥ|
yat kevalaṃ parama-śāntam anantam ādyam
ānanda-mātram avabhāti sad advitīyam||

units.label: Verse 772
units.deva:
यद् इदं परमं सत्यं तत्त्वं सच्-चित्-सुखात्मकम्।
अजरा-मरणं नित्यं सत्यम् एतद् वचो मम॥
units.translation: That Supreme Truth, the One Ultimate Reality, is That which is of the nature of existence, consciousness, and bliss. As Brahman knows neither old age nor death, That alone is the eternal truth, and these words of mine, which proclaim it, are true.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yad idaṃ paramaṃ satyaṃ tattvaṃ sac-cit-sukhātmakam|
ajarā-maraṇaṃ nityaṃ satyam etad vaco mama||

units.label: Verse 773
units.deva:
न हि त्वं देहोऽसाव् असुर् अपि च वाप्यक्ष-निकरो
मनो वा बुद्धिर् वा क्वचिद् अपि तथाहङ्-कृतिर् अपि।
न चैषां सङ्घातस् त्वमु भवसि विद्वन् शृणु परं
यद् एतेषां साक्षी स्फुरणम् अमलं तत् त्वम् असि हि॥
units.translation: Thou art not the physical body, nor the vital force, nor the sense-organs, nor the mind, nor the intellect, nor the ego. Thou art not any of these, either individually or collectively. 0 wise one, That supreme witnessing consciousness, that pure resplendent Being, That is none other than thee – Tat tvam asi, That thou art.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
na hi tvaṃ deho’sāv asur api ca vāpyakṣa-nikaro
mano vā buddhir vā kvacid api tathāhaṅ-kṛtir api|
na caiṣāṃ saṅghātas tvamu bhavasi vidvan śṛṇu paraṃ
yad eteṣāṃ sākṣī sphuraṇam amalaṃ tat tvam asi hi||

units.label: Verse 774
units.deva:
यज् जायते वस्तु तद् एव वर्धते
तद् एव मृत्युं समुपैति काले।
जन्मैव तेनास्ति तथैव मृत्युर्
नास्त्येव नित्यस्य विभोर् अजस्य॥
units.translation: Only that which is born could in succession undergo the process of growth and decay, and also to an end in the course of time. But that which is devoid of birth is also devoid of death. That eternal unborn Ātman – That thou art.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yaj jāyate vastu tad eva vardhate
tad eva mṛtyuṃ samupaiti kāle|
janmaiva tenāsti tathaiva mṛtyur
nāstyeva nityasya vibhor ajasya||

units.label: Verse 775
units.deva:
य एष देहो जनितः स एव
समेधते नश्यति कर्म-योगात्।
त्वम् एतदीयास्व् अखिलास्व् अवस्थास्व्
अवस्थितः साक्ष्यसि बोध-मात्रः॥
units.translation: It is only the physical body which is liable to be born, and that alone is also subject to death. Hence it is that the physical body is dissolved when the fruit of karma is exhausted. As for you, you are the witnessing consciousness which continues to survive in and through all these modifications. The Ātman ever remains what it is and is not subject to any kind of change.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
ya eṣa deho janitaḥ sa eva
samedhate naśyati karma-yogāt|
tvam etadīyāsv akhilāsv avasthāsv
avasthitaḥ sākṣyasi bodha-mātraḥ||

units.label: Verse 776
units.deva:
यत् स्व-प्रकाशम् अखिलात्मकम् आ-सुषुप्तेर्
एकात्मनाहम् अहम् इत्यवभाति नित्यम्।
बुद्धेः समस्त-विकृतेर् अविकारि बोद्धृ
यद् ब्रह्म तत् त्वम् असि केवल-बोध-मात्रम्॥
units.translation: It is this absolute pure consciousness which illumines all things both when we are awake and when we are dreaming. The Ātman makes itself manifest in every individual as the ego-consciousness; and remains unchanged through every modification of the intellect. That absolute pure consciousness – That thou art.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yat sva-prakāśam akhilātmakam ā-suṣupter
ekātmanāham aham ityavabhāti nityam|
buddheḥ samasta-vikṛter avikāri boddhṛ
yad brahma tat tvam asi kevala-bodha-mātram||

units.label: Verse 777
units.deva:
स्वात्मन्य् अनस्तमय-संविदि कल्पितस्य
व्योमादि-सर्व-जगतः प्रददाति सत्ताम्।
स्फूर्तिं स्वकीय-महसा वितनोति साक्षाद्
यद् ब्रह्म तत् त्वम् असि केवल-बोध-मात्रम्॥
units.translation: It is by the light of Brahman that this whole universe is made manifest by direct perception, as the immediate object of knowledge. It is by its all-pervading existence, in the whole universe, including in it the space and the like, that whatever is imagined to be has its being. That pure consciousness in which all sentient beings have their existence – That thou art.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
svātmany anastamaya-saṃvidi kalpitasya
vyomādi-sarva-jagataḥ pradadāti sattām|
sphūrtiṃ svakīya-mahasā vitanoti sākṣād
yad brahma tat tvam asi kevala-bodha-mātram||

units.label: Verse 778
units.deva:
सम्यक् समाधि-निरतैर् विमलान्तर्-अङ्गे
साक्षाद् अवेक्ष्य निज-तत्त्वम् अपार-सौख्यम्।
सन्तुष्यते परम-हंस-कुलैर् अजस्रं
यद् ब्रह्म तत् त्वम् असि केवल-बोध-मात्रम्॥
units.translation: The Absolute Brahman is ever present in the pure hearts of those who are absorbed in samādhi. Such persons are ever awake to the reality of the witnessing consciousness, and they are always absorbed in the transcendent bliss of that Reality. That unborn pure consciousness, in which the parama-haṃsas rejoice – That thou art. ((KathU.2.1.13) (Kaṭha Upaniṣad))
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
samyak samādhi-niratair vimalāntar-aṅge
sākṣād avekṣya nija-tattvam apāra-saukhyam|
santuṣyate parama-haṃsa-kulair ajasraṃ
yad brahma tat tvam asi kevala-bodha-mātram||

units.label: Verse 779
units.deva:
अन्तर् बहिः स्वयम् अखण्डितम् एक-रूपम्
आरोपितार्थवद् उदञ्चति मूढ-बुद्धेः।
मृत्-स्नादिवद् विगत-विक्रियम् आत्म-वेद्यं
यद् ब्रह्म तत् त्वम् असि केवल-बोध-मात्रम्॥
units.translation: As it rests upon its own nature, it permeates all objects both from within and from without. In itself, it remains it remains unborn and homogeneous. It is only the delusion of the intellect that superimposes various objects upon it. Just as clay constitutes the fundamental basis of all the objects that are made of clay, so also this unchanging reality constitutes the fundamental basis of all that is perceived. That absolute pure consciousness – That thou art.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
antar bahiḥ svayam akhaṇḍitam eka-rūpam
āropitārthavad udañcati mūḍha-buddheḥ|
mṛt-snādivad vigata-vikriyam ātma-vedyaṃ
yad brahma tat tvam asi kevala-bodha-mātram||

units.label: Verse 780
units.deva:
श्रुत्युक्तम् अव्ययम् अनन्तम् अनादि-मध्यम्
अव्यक्तम् अक्षरम् अनाश्रयम् अप्रमेयम्।
आनन्द-सद्-घनम् अनामयम् अद्वितीयं
यद् ब्रह्म तत् त्वम् असि केवल-बोध-मात्रम्॥
units.translation: The Śruti refers to it as That which knows no decay, which has no finitude, which has neither beginning nor middle, and which is devoid of all other distinguishing traits. That alone is imperishable. It does not depend upon anything other than itself; it is not an object of knowledge; it is free from defects; it is compact of bliss, and is non-dual in nature. That absolute pure consciousness – That thou art. ((BrhUEng.4.4.19) (Bṛhad-Āraṇyaka Upaniṣad))
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
śrutyuktam avyayam anantam anādi-madhyam
avyaktam akṣaram anāśrayam aprameyam|
ānanda-sad-ghanam anāmayam advitīyaṃ
yad brahma tat tvam asi kevala-bodha-mātram||

units.label: Verse 781
units.deva:
शरीर-तद्-योग-तदीय-धर्माद्य्-
आरोपणं भ्रान्ति-वशात् त्वदीयम्।
न वस्तुतः किञ्चिद् अतस् त्व् अजस् त्वं
मृत्योर् भयं क्वास्ति तवासि पूर्णः॥
units.translation: By superimposing upon pure consciousness attributes of a jīva, you imagine that you have become a jīva, an embodied being. But such is not the case; you are in reality the unborn Ātman, You are the ever perfect; what need is there; what for you to fear death?
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
śarīra-tad-yoga-tadīya-dharmādy-
āropaṇaṃ bhrānti-vaśāt tvadīyam|
na vastutaḥ kiñcid atas tv ajas tvaṃ
mṛtyor bhayaṃ kvāsti tavāsi pūrṇaḥ||

units.label: Verse 782
units.deva:
यद् यद् दृष्टं भ्रान्तिमत्या स्व-दृष्ट्या
तत् तत् सम्यग् वस्तु-दृष्ट्या त्वम् एव।
त्वत्तो नान्यद् वस्तु किञ्चित् तु लोके
कस्माद् भीतिस् ते भवेद् अद्वयस्य॥
units.translation: With the dawning of right knowledge, even that which was perceived in a state of delusion would be found to be other than the Ātman. In all this wide world there is nothing real other than the Ātman and you are that non-dual Ātman. Why should you be afraid of anything?
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
yad yad dṛṣṭaṃ bhrāntimatyā sva-dṛṣṭyā
tat tat samyag vastu-dṛṣṭyā tvam eva|
tvatto nānyad vastu kiñcit tu loke
kasmād bhītis te bhaved advayasya||

units.label: Verse 783
units.deva:
पश्यतस् त्वहम् एवेदं सर्वम् इत्यात्मनाखिलम्।
भयं स्याद् विदुषः कस्मात् स्वस्मान् न भयमिष्यते॥
units.translation: Why should there be any fear at all for one who knows Brahman? To one who considers the whole universe as one’s Ātman, and who also knows, ‘I am all these’, it is most unreasonable that one should be afraid of anything.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
paśyatas tvaham evedaṃ sarvam ityātmanākhilam|
bhayaṃ syād viduṣaḥ kasmāt svasmān na bhayamiṣyate||

units.label: Verse 784
units.deva:
तस्मात् त्वम् अभयं नित्यं केवलानन्द-लक्षणम्।
निष्कलं निष्क्रियं शान्तं ब्रह्मैवासि सदाद्वयम्॥
units.translation: You are therefore none other than Brahman; and Brahman is devoid of fear, is eternal and of the nature of bliss. It is also devoid of parts, is actionless, and ever tranquil; for it is ever the One without a second.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tasmāt tvam abhayaṃ nityaṃ kevalānanda-lakṣaṇam|
niṣkalaṃ niṣkriyaṃ śāntaṃ brahmaivāsi sadādvayam||

units.label: Verse 785
units.deva:
ज्ञातृ-ज्ञान-ज्ञेय-विहीनं ज्ञातुर् अभिन्नं ज्ञानम् अखण्डम्।
ज्ञेयाज्ञेयत्वादि-विमुक्तं शुद्धं बुद्धं तत्त्वम् असि त्वम्॥
units.translation: All those distinctions, such as the knower, the means of knowledge and that which is the object of knowledge, have no place in Brahman. That is because Brahman is compact of bliss and is the eternal seer. Therefore it is not an object of knowledge; while it is at the same time not unknowable – Thou art that pure consciousness.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
jñātṛ-jñāna-jñeya-vihīnaṃ jñātur abhinnaṃ jñānam akhaṇḍam|
jñeyājñeyatvādi-vimuktaṃ śuddhaṃ buddhaṃ tattvam asi tvam||

units.label: Verse 786
units.deva:
अन्तः-प्रज्ञत्वादि-विकल्पैर् अस्पृष्टं यत् तद् दृशि-मात्रम्।
सत्ता-मात्रं सम-रसम् एकं शुद्धं बुद्धं तत्त्वम् असि त्वम्॥
units.translation: That whose nature is not stained by any of the levels of consciousness, whose nature is pure knowledge and pure existence, who is homogeneous in nature, ever free and ever awake – That thou art.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
antaḥ-prajñatvādi-vikalpair aspṛṣṭaṃ yat tad dṛśi-mātram|
sattā-mātraṃ sama-rasam ekaṃ śuddhaṃ buddhaṃ tattvam asi tvam||

units.label: Verse 787
units.deva:
सर्वाकारं सर्वम् असर्वं सर्व-निषेधावधि-भूतं यत्।
सत्यं शाश्वतम् एकम् अनन्तं शुद्धं बुद्धं तत्त्वम् असि त्वम्॥
units.translation: That which is the Ātman of us all permeates all the forms of life, itself remaining formless. It is the substratum of all, in which all the diversities of name and form have ceased to be. That infinite truth, that eternal pure consciousness, That thou art.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
sarvākāraṃ sarvam asarvaṃ sarva-niṣedhāvadhi-bhūtaṃ yat|
satyaṃ śāśvatam ekam anantaṃ śuddhaṃ buddhaṃ tattvam asi tvam||

units.label: Verse 788
units.deva:
नित्यानन्दाखण्डैक-रसं निष्कलम् अक्रियम् अस्त-विकारम्।
प्रत्यग्-अभिन्नं परम-व्यक्तं शुद्धं बुद्धं तत्त्वम् असि त्वम्॥
units.translation: That eternal bliss knows no division within itself, for it is homogeneous in nature. It is not a product of action; for it ever remains unmodified by action. That is the Ātman of us all. That supreme, unmanifest, pure consciousness – That thou art.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
nityānandākhaṇḍaika-rasaṃ niṣkalam akriyam asta-vikāram|
pratyag-abhinnaṃ parama-vyaktaṃ śuddhaṃ buddhaṃ tattvam asi tvam||

units.label: Verse 789
units.deva:
त्वं प्रत्यस्ताशेष-विशेषं व्योमेवान्तर् बहिर् अपि पूर्णम्।
ब्रह्मानन्दं परम् अद्वैतं शुद्धं बुद्धं तत्त्वम् असि त्वम्॥
units.translation: That which permeates all, which nothing transcends, and which like the universal space around us fills everything completely, from within and from without, that supreme non-dual Brahman - That thou art.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
tvaṃ pratyastāśeṣa-viśeṣaṃ vyomevāntar bahir api pūrṇam|
brahmānandaṃ param advaitaṃ śuddhaṃ buddhaṃ tattvam asi tvam||

units.label: Verse 790
units.deva:
ब्रह्मैवाहम् अहं ब्रह्म निर्गुणं निर्विकल्पकम्।
इत्येवाखण्डया वृत्त्या तिष्ठ ब्रह्मणि निष्क्रिये॥
units.translation: ‘Brahman is my Ātman; my Ātman is Brahman.’ To know that, is to transcend the guṇas, and be beyond all that change. Be thou ever absorbed in meditating upon that which never changes, which is eternal, and which lies beyond all creative activity.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
brahmaivāham ahaṃ brahma nirguṇaṃ nirvikalpakam|
ityevākhaṇḍayā vṛttyā tiṣṭha brahmaṇi niṣkriye||

units.label: Verse 791
units.deva:
अखण्डाम् एवैतां घटित-परमानन्द-लहरीं
परिध्वस्त-द्वैत-प्रमितिम् अमलां वृत्तिम् अनिशम्॥
अमुञ्चानः स्वात्मन्य् अनुपम-सुखे ब्रह्मणि परे
रमस्व प्रारब्धं क्षपय सुख-वृत्त्या त्वम् अनया॥
units.translation: By continuous and uninterrupted meditation upon that out of which arise the waves of bliss which inundate all duality, not only do you attain the supreme bliss, but you also check the force of prārabdha, the subtle effect of past actions, and weaken its sway in the present.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
akhaṇḍām evaitāṃ ghaṭita-paramānanda-laharīṃ
paridhvasta-dvaita-pramitim amalāṃ vṛttim aniśam||
amuñcānaḥ svātmany anupama-sukhe brahmaṇi pare
ramasva prārabdhaṃ kṣapaya sukha-vṛttyā tvam anayā||

units.label: Verse 792
units.deva:
ब्रह्मानन्द-रसास्वाद-तत्-परेणैव चेतसा।
समाधि-निष्ठितो भूत्वा तिष्ठ विद्वन् सदा मुने॥
units.translation: O thou learned sage! Be thou ever absorbed in deep concentration and enjoy the bliss of Brahman.
units.sectionTitle: You are Only that Ultimate Reality
units.iast:
brahmānanda-rasāsvāda-tat-pareṇaiva cetasā|
samādhi-niṣṭhito bhūtvā tiṣṭha vidvan sadā mune||

units.label: Verse 793
units.deva:
अखण्डाख्या वृत्तिर् एषा वाक्यार्थ-श्रुति-मात्रतः।
श्रोतुः सञ्जायते किं वा क्रियान्तरम् अपेक्षते॥
units.translation: The disciple asks: Revered Sir, in order to realize that supreme bliss, would merely listening to a sentence like, ‘That thou art’ be enough? Can one attain by it that indivisible reality which lies beyond all the modifications of the mind? Or is it essential that one should do something in order to realize it?
units.iast:
akhaṇḍākhyā vṛttir eṣā vākyārtha-śruti-mātrataḥ|
śrotuḥ sañjāyate kiṃ vā kriyāntaram apekṣate||

units.label: Verse 794
units.deva:
समाधिः कः कति-विधस् तत्-सिद्धेः किमु साधनम्।
समाधेर् अन्तरायाः के सर्वम् एतन् निरूप्यताम्॥
units.translation: What is meant by ‘samādhi’? In how many ways may we realize samādhi? What are the various means of realization? What are the hindrances in the path? Be gracious enough to explain all this to me.
units.iast:
samādhiḥ kaḥ kati-vidhas tat-siddheḥ kimu sādhanam|
samādher antarāyāḥ ke sarvam etan nirūpyatām||

units.label: Verse 795
units.deva:
मुख्य-गौणादि-भेदेन विद्यन्तेऽत्राधिकारिणः।
तेषां प्रज्ञानुसारेणाखण्डा वृत्तिर् उदेष्यते॥
units.translation: The fitness of the aspirant The spiritual guide says: There are two types of aspirants: both of them are fit to receive this knowledge. They have been classed as those who are pre-eminently qualified, and those who are only moderately qualified. It depends upon their capacity for realization; thus it is that there rises in them a corresponding mental modification.
units.iast:
mukhya-gauṇādi-bhedena vidyante’trādhikāriṇaḥ|
teṣāṃ prajñānusāreṇākhaṇḍā vṛttir udeṣyate||

units.label: Verse 796
units.deva:
श्रद्धा-भक्ति-पुरः-सरेण विहितेनैवेश्वरं कर्मणा
सन्तोष्यार्जित-तत्-प्रसाद-महिमा जन्मान्तरेष्वेव यः।
नित्यानित्य-विवेक-तीव्र-विरति-न्यासादिभिः साधनैर्
